bead.title: Amend SD-008 §6 — Multi-harness extension
bead.description: Add Section 6 'Multi-Harness Extension' to docs/helix/02-design/solution-designs/SD-008-terminal-bench-integration.md: (a) in-container installability checklist for non-ddx-agent harnesses (current §1 covers ddx-agent BaseInstalledAgent flow only); (b) per-harness adapter file location at scripts/benchmark/harness_adapters/; (c) egress requirements for harnesses calling provider APIs from inside the container; (d) drop rule — harnesses that can't be installed in-container are documented and excluded, NOT run host-side. Cross-references SD-010.
bead.acceptance: New §6 lands in SD-008; cross-references SD-010 by ID; existing §1-§5 unchanged.
